profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
I'm a senior software engineer with a concentration on the front end. I love all things JavaScript and have been developing for the web since 2012. I'm a lifelong learner and enjoy teaching programming topics in general.

I blog about front end tech at derekndavis.com.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Building Org apps from the ground up, the next iteration of Power BI Apps
- Developing and scaling Fabric Dev Tools, a browser extension used by hundreds across Power BI & Fabric
- Worked on bringing paginated report authoring to the web and made it more intuitive for our users

positions.title: (Side Contract) Contract Software Developer
positions.description:
Fully redesigned and migrated idezi.com from WordPress to ASP.Net MVC 5 and created an admin portal written in Angular for making changes to the website.

Technologies: C#, ASP.Net MVC 5, MS SQL Server, Bootstrap, AngularJS, jQuery, SEO

Also developed various inventory programs for Windows Mobile in C# and adapted them to work for several devices
